Our first adventure

A little raccoon.
A big adventure.

Meet Trash Dash, our 2D side-scrolling adventure.

When the purple-black Gunk begins corrupting the animals around Trashy’s forest home, he and his best friend Jimothy follow it beyond the woods to help the creatures caught in it. Their journey moves from forest to suburbia to city.

It’s a character-driven, humorous adventure where infected animals are victims, not disposable enemies.

In development · Launching in 2026

Planned for Steam, the App Store, and Google Play.
